name: Szentkirály (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szentkirály: a crowned blue and green shield with a red arm holding a bunch of grapes and a yellow crown, above a yellow scroll inscribed SZENTKIRÁLY 1354.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szentkirály arms with crown and scroll
